entries.title: Hosea 11:1
segments: When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.

entries.title: Hosea 11:2
segments: The more [the prophets] called them, the more they went from them: they sacrificed unto the Baalim, and burned incense to graven images.

entries.title: Hosea 11:3
segments: Yet I taught Ephraim to walk; I took them on my arms; but they knew not that I healed them.

entries.title: Hosea 11:4
segments: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love; and I was to them as they that lift up the yoke on their jaws; and I laid food before them.

entries.title: Hosea 11:5
segments: They shall not return into the land of Egypt; but the Assyrian shall be their king, because they refused to return [to me].

entries.title: Hosea 11:6
segments: And the sword shall fall upon their cities, and shall consume their bars, and devour [them], because of their own counsels.

entries.title: Hosea 11:7
segments: And my people are bent on backsliding from me: though they call them to [him that is] on high, none at all will exalt [him].

entries.title: Hosea 11:8
segments: How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? [how] shall I cast thee off, Israel? how shall I make thee as Admah? [how] shall I set thee as Zeboiim? my heart is turned within me, my compassions are kindled together.

entries.title: Hosea 11:9
segments: I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger, I will not return to destroy Ephraim: for I am God, and not man; the Holy One in the midst of thee; and I will not come in wrath.

entries.title: Hosea 11:10
segments: They shall walk after Jehovah, who will roar like a lion; for he will roar, and the children shall come trembling from the west.

entries.title: Hosea 11:11
segments: They shall come trembling as a bird out of Egypt, and as a dove out of the land of Assyria; and I will make them to dwell in their houses, saith Jehovah.

entries.title: Hosea 11:12
segments: Ephraim compasseth me about with falsehood, and the house of Israel with deceit; but Judah yet ruleth with God, and is faithful with the Holy One.
